annotations.title: Fuel prices for a state, city or ZIP

description: Diesel and gasoline prices per gallon, fuel taxes and monthly price history for one US state, city or ZIP. Only ten cities have their own survey; any other city or ZIP returns its state's average, and each price says which it is. These are area averages, not station prices.

months.description: How many of the most recent months to return. Default 24. History starts 2003-12.

place.description: A state ("TX" or "Texas"), a city and state ("Chicago, IL"), or a 5-digit ZIP. Lower 48 states and DC.

name: get_local_fuel_prices
